name: Tatia Global Venture Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Tatia Global Venture Ltd 
is in the business of textiles and infrastructure related projects[1]
keyPoints:
Business Objectives:[1]
a) TGVL operates in textiles and infrastructure projects & ventures.
b) The company holds land banks through its wholly owned subsidiaries to support their growth

pros: Stock is trading at 1.08 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 25.9% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
